title: Toolchain manifest
description: One adopter-owned declaration of toolchain identity, materialized at .devai/config/toolchain.json from the law default under law/policy/adopter-defaults/toolchain.json. Workflows, the workflow checker, the provisioning script, and the runner's toolchain probe consume this manifest instead of restating versions inline (ADR-CHK-0002). It declares exact runtime versions, every pinned GitHub Action digest with the ref it was pinned from, the trusted verifier package by name and version with a reference to the trusted verifier policy, and the named repository constants a workflow must agree with.

exact_version.description: Exact semantic version without a leading v. Consumers normalize observed output (for example process.version or git --version) before comparing.

ref.description: The tag or branch the digest was pinned from, kept for human review; it never appears in a uses: reference.

digest.description: The immutable object that every uses: reference must carry. For an annotated tag this is the tag object accepted by Actions, not its peeled commit.

peeled_commit.description: Present only when digest is an annotated tag object: the commit it peels to, so a checker can recognize both identities without demanding a repin.

runtimes.description: Exact versions the executing host must provide. Workflows may pin a major only; the checker compares the major against node and the full version where a workflow states one.

pnpm.description: Must agree with the version in the packageManager field of package.json.

actions.description: Map from GitHub Action repository (owner/name) to its pinned identity. Every action a workflow references must appear here and every entry must be referenced by its digest.

verifier.description: Identity of the trusted release-candidate verifier package. Tarball digests, source commit, and materialization rules stay in the referenced policy and are never copied here.

policy.description: Repository-relative path of the trusted verifier policy this manifest defers to. The package name and version above must equal that policy's package.name and package.version.

constants.description: Named repository constants that a workflow restates and must agree with. Absent constants are not checked.

expected_action_count.description: Size of the approved action set in law/policy/action-registry.json, as the release workflow's EXPECTED_ACTION_COUNT environment value.

ledger_environment.description: Name of the protected deployment environment the ledger verification workflow binds.
